speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help you, I need to ask a few questions. Has the rash appeared suddenly or developed gradually, and is your baby feeling feverish or irritable?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Gonococcal Ophthalmia Neonatorum with disseminated infection (rash). REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture, Gram Stain of rash lesions, and Ophthalmology Exam. REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skin exam photograph.
